main.remarks: This class defines the elements of a Metadata Information Base.

field.name: Application
field.summary: Application Directory Partition | Naming Context | Unique Name.

field.name: FILE
field.summary: Content stream file path or name.

field.name: Notes
field.remarks: A collection of unstructured text for any purpose.

field.name: ObjectFILE
field.summary: Preferred or current serialized object file path or name.

field.name: InheritanceCache
field.summary: Cached inheritance metadata by runtime type.

field.name: Tags
field.remarks: Any grouping or classifying string, such as those defined in Tags.cs.

method.name: GetCachedInheritanceList
method.summary: Get cached inheritance metadata for the current runtime type.

method.name: GetObjectFILE
method.returns: Preferred or current serialized object file path or name.

method.name: SetObjectFILE
method.param: Preferred or current serialized object file path or name.
method.returns: True if ObjectFILE was set successfully.

method.name: ClearCachedFileSize_NoSync
method.summary: Clear the cached file size without acquiring synchronization locks.

method.name: ResolveCachedFileSize_NoSync
method.summary: Resolve the cached backing-file size without acquiring synchronization locks.
method.returns: The cached or probed backing-file size.

method.name: SetCachedFileSize_NoSync
method.summary: Set the cached file size without acquiring synchronization locks.

method.name: CreateIsolatedSet
method.summary: Create an isolated string set while preserving per-element string cloning semantics.
method.returns: An isolated set containing cloned strings from the source sequence.

method.name: SetModified_NoSync
method.summary: Set Last Modified Time without synchronization.
method.returns: Returns true if Last Modified Time was updated successfully.

method.name: ModifiedNow
method.summary: Set Last Modified Time to DateTimeOffset.Now.
method.returns: Returns true if Last Modified Time was updated successfully.
